The earliest documents mentioning the name "Mozart", then spelled "Motzhart" or "Motzhardt", are from the Bavarian part of Swabia. The direct bloodline ended when Mozart's last surviving son, Karl Thomas Mozart, died on October 31, 1858, without children.
